reviewer: Seed-0 witness review (ora qualify robolab contract-witness)
scope: robolab ClutterPumpkinTask at the pinned revision; generated per predicate family (in_container); seed-0 witness pending. Semantic projection of the official termination, not physical qualification.
task_language: Put all the pumpkins away in the bin

predicate_and_helpers.basis: Read ClutterPumpkinTask terminations: success = object_in_container(object=['pumpkinlarge', 'pumpkinsmall'], container='right_bin', logical='all', require_gripper_detached=True), and the helpers in conditionals.py and predicate_logic.py; RobolabEnv records success as the TerminationManager's terminated flag, the OR of every non-timeout term.

reset_and_randomization.basis: Scene clutter_fruit_bottle_bluebin.usda: pumpkinlarge, pumpkinsmall, right_bin among 18 contact objects. The env's only event is reset_scene_to_default and the task adds none, so every seed resets to the same authored layout; a seed varies physics only.

assets_and_frames.basis: Containment tests the centroid of the object's convex hull in the container's local frame against the container hull with its top faces removed (hull_check), so a tipped container fails and the region above the open top counts.

success_timing.basis: DoneTerm success is evaluated every control step; RobolabEnv freezes the env at the first true step (a termination within its first two steps is reset as a physics artifact) and the ORA session latches it.

public_observability.basis: At reset every named object (3) projects into the over-shoulder or wrist camera with a depth reading that does not hide it (witness sha256 9e44f7c87856).

success_witness.basis: Witness (seed 0, sha256 9e44f7c87856): all_in -> True; each case from a fresh reset, objects placed by direct state edits with the robot held.

counterexamples.basis: Witness (seed 0, sha256 9e44f7c87856): reset_state -> False; beside -> False; all_but_one -> False.

no_expert_strategy.basis: Clauses state end conditions only; no approach, grasp, route or motion advice.

privacy.basis: No coordinates, thresholds, fixture or object identifiers, joint values or predicate names enter the public text; numeric limits stay in this private record.

conditions.source_basis: success = object_in_container(object=['pumpkinlarge', 'pumpkinsmall'], container='right_bin', logical='all', require_gripper_detached=True): the object's convex-hull centroid inside the container's hull with its top faces removed, in the container's local frame.
conditions.interpretation: The large pumpkin and the small pumpkin in the bin.

conditions.source_basis: require_gripper_detached=True: gripper_detached checks that no gripper body touches the object above 0.1 N.
conditions.interpretation: Release: the gripper touches none of the named objects.
Hull slack, contact force bar and the open-top hull construction withheld.

public_clauses: Both the large pumpkin and the small pumpkin must end up inside the bin.
Let go of each of them: the task is not complete while the gripper still touches either one.

counterexamples.case: Objects in place while one is still gripped: false by gripper_detached (source-derived, not executed).

notes.detail: official limit 1350 native actions (90 s at 15 Hz; 4050 under the default extended budget), against 900 for the longest task admitted before
no face of the large pumpkin fits the open gripper (85 mm); a grasp needs a rim, handle, stem or edge

witness_plan.note: each case starts from a fresh reset of seed 0; the robot holds its reset pose with the gripper open unless a case grasps; success is any official result over the case's ticks

limitations: Generated from the pinned source; the witness (phase B) covers seed 0 only and uses direct state edits or scripted moves, never a policy rollout. Source-derived negative cases marked as such are not executed.
